module: Camera that follows a camera path (core_paths: markers with position, rotation, FOV, time). Interpolates position by chordal Catmull-Rom with normalized time (monotone Steffen), rotation by centripetal Catmull-Rom (nlerp) and FOV/nearClip by Steffen. Handles: cuts (marker.cut), markers attached to the vehicle (attachToVehicle, poses in vehicle frame), vehicle tracking (trackPosition, with trackOffset offset), per-marker Bezier motion curves (motion*, rotMotion*, yaw/pitch/rollMotion*), moving starts/ends (movingStart/movingEnd), manual zoom (path.manualFov), looping (path.looped) and replay-linked paths (path.replay, bullettime speed). Returns a constructor.
usage:
-- the path comes from core_paths; customData can provide getNextPath(), onNextControlPoint(n, total), finishedPath(), reset(), useJsonVersion, useDtReal, offset, path
core_camera.setByName(0, 'path', false, {getNextPath = function() return 'monChemin' end})
notes: Two modes: useJsonVersion = true (customData.getNextPath returns the path table, absolute times per marker); otherwise the path is looked up by name (core_paths.getPath(pathName)) and marker.time is the duration to the next marker (cumulative).
Does nothing if there are fewer than 2 markers. Uses data.dtSim (or dtReal if customData.useDtReal).
Set of marker fields read: pos, rot, fov, nearClip, time, cut, attachToVehicle, trackPosition, trackOffset{x,y,z}, movingStart, movingEnd, positionSmooth, motion*(Out|In|OutTime|InTime), bullettime.
The tracking offset comes from the markers, otherwise, as a fallback, from editor_camPathEditor or from a pathCameraEditor.getTrackingOffset() extension.
A TODO in the code notes that rotation with movingEnd does not have the right timing.
The signatures of the extracted page are inaccurate: getTimeToNext(path, index) and getGlobalTime(path, index, looped).
update modifies the markers' quaternions (sign inversion) to avoid interpolation jumps.

C.desc: Path mode. Fields: ctrlPoint, camT (current time in s), customData, path, pathName, fovOffset.

init.desc: isGlobal = true, hidden = true, initial state.

getTimeToNext.desc: Duration between marker index and the next (last marker: loop duration or 2 s in JSON mode).

getGlobalTime.desc: Absolute time of marker index since the start of the path.

looped.desc: looped path (marker 1 then equals the last one's time + loop duration, JSON mode)

update.desc: Advances time, interpolates the camera and writes data.res (pos, rot, fov, nearClip), calls the customData callbacks and handles the end/loop of the path.

returns.desc: true; nil if no valid path

setCustomData.desc: Resets the mode and sets the course data; start time = customData.offset. If the path has a replay, loads it (or ignores it if it does not exist).

data.desc: customData: getNextPath, path, offset, useJsonVersion, useDtReal, onNextControlPoint, finishedPath, reset

reset.desc: Resets time, control point, FOV offset and path names to zero (calls customData:reset if it exists).
